tldr: 台股單日重挫約千點，但研華、麗臺等AI相關強勢股受獲利與外資買盤支撐逆勢收紅。
AI基礎建設持續帶動企業資本支出與籌資題材，光寶科上修資本支出，科技債與信用市場機會受策略師青睞。
記憶體類股閃現反轉警訊，SanDisk財報優於預期仍重挫，顯示NAND漲價循環恐近見頂。

items.title_zh: 研華Q3獲利創高、逆勢收紅
items.title_en: Advantech bucks a sharp TAIEX plunge with record Q3 profit
items.summary_zh: 工業電腦與AIoT大廠研華公布第三季獲利創新高並釋出正向展望，股價無懼大盤單日重挫約千點逆勢翻紅。此表現凸顯在AI邊緣運算與自動化需求支撐下，基本面穩健的個股可與大盤弱勢脫鉤，提醒投資人於指數劇烈波動之際，更應回歸企業獲利品質作為選股核心。
items.summary_en: Industrial-PC and AIoT maker Advantech closed higher even as Taiwan's benchmark index tumbled roughly a thousand points, after reporting record third-quarter earnings and offering an upbeat outlook. The resilient move underscores how firms with solid AI-edge and automation demand can decouple from broad market weakness, pulling investor focus back toward earnings quality rather than index-level swings.

items.title_zh: 麗臺輝達工作站加持、外資逆勢買超
items.title_en: Leadtek defies the pullback as foreign funds buy its Nvidia workstation push
items.summary_zh: 顯卡與工作站供應商麗臺受惠輝達新款工作站產品與獲利爆發，股價無懼大盤回檔逆勢走高，並獲外資轉為買超。此逆勢資金流入顯示市場對直接連結AI硬體建置的個股仍具選擇性偏好，即使大盤進入修正，AI相關強勢股與其餘類股的表現落差持續擴大。
items.summary_en: Graphics-card and workstation supplier Leadtek rose against a falling market, lifted by new Nvidia-based workstation products and surging earnings, with foreign institutions turning net buyers. The counter-trend inflow signals selective appetite for names tied directly to AI hardware build-out even as the broader index corrects, highlighting a widening gap between AI-levered stocks and the rest of the board.

items.title_zh: 光寶科上修資本支出至197億元、押注AI電源
items.title_en: Lite-On raises capex to NT$19.7bn as AI power demand builds
items.summary_zh: 光寶科將資本支出計畫上修至新台幣197億元，表示AI伺服器電源出貨將視客戶資料中心供電進度而定。此舉反映對AI基礎建設訂單延續性的信心，使台廠電源零組件供應商成為AI擴建主要受惠者；惟實際出貨節奏仍取決於雲端大廠為新資料中心取得電力的速度。
items.summary_en: Lite-On Technology lifted its capital-expenditure plan to NT$19.7 billion, saying shipments of AI server power supplies will track customers' data-center power-provisioning schedules. The upgraded spending reflects confidence in sustained AI infrastructure orders and positions Taiwan's power-component makers as key beneficiaries of the build-out, though the pace will hinge on how quickly hyperscalers secure electricity for new facilities.

items.title_zh: SanDisk財報優於預期仍重挫13%、記憶體反轉警報
items.title_en: Memory stocks wobble as SanDisk slides 13% despite an earnings beat
items.summary_zh: SanDisk財報優於市場預期，股價卻重挫約13%，主因同業鎧俠示警NAND漲價動能降溫，引發記憶體類股反轉警訊。市場似乎開始反映本波記憶體景氣見頂的疑慮，台廠NAND相關供應鏈與模組業者須密切觀察後續接單與報價變化，以評估漲價循環是否接近尾聲。
items.summary_en: SanDisk shares tumbled about 13% even after a better-than-expected report, as peer Kioxia flagged that the recent NAND price up-cycle is cooling, triggering a reversal warning across memory names. The move suggests the market is pricing in a peak in the current memory boom—a signal Taiwan's NAND-related suppliers and module makers will watch closely for order and pricing implications.

items.title_zh: 一銀開國銀首槍、紅利點數可兌USDT
items.title_en: First Bank becomes the first local lender to convert loyalty points into USDT
items.summary_zh: 第一銀行攜手交易所HOYA BIT，推出粉獅幣點數可兌換穩定幣USDT的服務，為國內銀行首例。此合作象徵傳統銀行以謹慎方式跨入加密生態系，試探監理邊界，也顯示本土銀行可能藉由數位資產相關服務，爭取年輕及偏好虛擬資產的客群，為金融與幣圈結合揭開新頁。
items.summary_en: First Commercial Bank partnered with exchange HOYA BIT to let customers redeem its "Lion Coin" reward points for the USDT stablecoin, a first among Taiwan's banks. The tie-up marks a cautious step by a traditional lender into the crypto ecosystem, testing regulatory boundaries and signaling how domestic banks may court younger, digital-asset-minded customers.

items.title_zh: 黑石示警：Anthropic上市後恐僅獲垃圾評級、融資成本攀升
items.title_en: Blackstone warns Anthropic could draw 'junk' ratings post-IPO, lifting financing costs
items.summary_zh: 黑石警告，AI開發商Anthropic若完成首次公開發行，信用評級恐僅達垃圾等級，將推升其舉債成本。此說法凸顯市場對資本密集型AI企業籌資方式的關注升溫，對銀行放款、債券投資人及支撐AI融資熱潮的信用環境均有直接影響，提醒投資人留意相關信用風險。
items.summary_en: Blackstone cautioned that AI developer Anthropic might only secure junk-grade credit ratings after a potential IPO, which would push up its borrowing costs. The remark spotlights growing scrutiny of how capital-intensive AI firms will fund themselves—a theme with direct implications for lenders, bond investors and the credit conditions underpinning the AI financing boom.

items.title_zh: 科技債成「待發掘鑽石」、AI舉債潮創固收機會
items.title_en: Tech bonds called a 'diamond in the rough' as AI giants ramp up borrowing
items.summary_zh: 策略師指出，隨著AI巨頭大舉發債籌措擴建資金，所衍生的科技類債券對追求收益的固定收益投資人而言，是一項被低估的機會。對財富管理客戶來說，此觀點凸顯可透過選擇性布局海外債與信用債，參與AI主題行情，同時避免直接承擔股票估值波動風險，兼顧收益與風險分散。
items.summary_en: Strategists argue that as AI heavyweights issue large volumes of debt to fund build-outs, the resulting tech-sector bonds offer an underappreciated opportunity for fixed-income investors seeking yield from quality issuers. For wealth clients, the view flags selective overseas-bond and credit allocations as a way to join the AI theme without taking direct equity-valuation risk.

items.title_zh: 木頭姐大砍禮來、加碼Tempus AI與Coinbase
items.title_en: Cathie Wood's ARK trims Eli Lilly, adds Tempus AI and Coinbase
items.summary_zh: 方舟投資（ARK）賣出約2421萬美元禮來持股，同時加碼Tempus AI與Coinbase，持倉轉向AI醫療與加密貨幣相關標的。這檔高知名度基金的調節，為財富管理投資人提供積極成長型經理人對下一波機會布局的參考；惟此類集中且主題式押注，也凸顯追逐顛覆性創新標的所伴隨的高波動風險。
items.summary_en: Ark Invest sold about US$24.21 million of Eli Lilly while adding to Tempus AI and Coinbase, rotating toward AI-in-healthcare and crypto-linked exposure. The high-profile fund's reshuffle offers wealth investors a read on where an aggressive growth manager sees the next leg of opportunity, though such concentrated, thematic bets also underscore the volatility that comes with chasing disruptive-innovation names.
